comments.comment:
Vlad, as I see you already created a test that reproduces this issue - AtomicBinaryOffheapBatchTest.
Please add such important info to the ticket the next time so that the one who will be working on the ticket don't need to reproduce the issue on its own.

I would like to ask you to talk to ashutak and add such a test for different cache configurations (cache modes, sync types, Externalizeble, Serializable, etc..) using our new test framework. This may help to reveal other issues.

Presently I removed AtomicBinaryOffheapBatchTest from the SQL test suite because it should be added to another one.
So, well this issue is reproduced only when several keys and values types are pre-configured for a single cache.
This issue has reproduced even to define one indexed type. You can see this in attachment.

Added non-threaded test reproducing the issue.
The issue seems to be related to enabled on-heap row cache.
https://github.com/ascherbakoff/ignite/commit/5ce7904cf548ba15519bac37841bd2fbf949710c

I've refactored attached code to several smaller tests repoducing some bad cache behavior then indexing is enabled.
Was able to fix first of them.
Working on others.

Started the discussion on the dev list with the topic "Cache errors with enabled indexing"
to clarify next steps on this issue.
Refactored tests to single and multiple cache value types.
Reviewed changes, more correct fix it to check that BinaryObjectOffheapImpl is not passed to indexing in GridCacheMapEntry (fixed this). Need check TC.
